auth.nativeCredentialPath: HARBOR_HOST + HARBOR_USERNAME/PASSWORD Basic for API; scoped robot credentials for registry, exact host-specific Docker auth. CN canonical /service/token realm may use -pub while registry is private.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: Have authorized admin issue project/system robot with intended scopes; use docker login --password-stdin only when authorized. Do not print robot secret as old business example suggests.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: GET /api/v2.0/users/current for human account where supported; target project/repository read plus registry Bearer challenge realm/service/scope. Robot identity comes from robot metadata, not assumed human endpoint.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: Robot creation/refresh/disable/delete per supported version; expires_at and project/system scopes differ. Push automation also needs pull for HEAD manifest; token realm endpoint consumes account credential.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
